ruleDefinitions.name: Registry Export of Third-Party Credentials
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of reg.exe to export registry paths associated with third-party credentials.
Credential stealers have been known to use this technique to extract sensitive information from the registry.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*save.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*export.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Aerofox\\\\Foxmail\\\\V3\\\.1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Aerofox\\\\FoxmailPreview.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\DownloadManager\\\\Passwords.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\FTPWare\\\\COREFTP\\\\Sites.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\IncrediMail\\\\Identities.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Martin\\ Prikryl\\\\WinSCP\\ 2\\\\Sessions.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Mobatek\\\\MobaXterm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\OpenSSH\\\\Agent\\\\Keys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\OpenVPN\\-GUI\\\\configs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\ORL\\\\WinVNC3\\\\Password.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Qualcomm\\\\Eudora\\\\CommandLine.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\RealVNC\\\\WinVNC4.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\RimArts\\\\B2\\\\Settings.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\SimonTatham\\\\PuTTY\\\\Sessions.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\SimonTatham\\\\PuTTY\\\\SshHostKeys.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Sota\\\\FFFTP.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\TightVNC\\\\Server.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\WOW6432Node\\\\Radmin\\\\v3\\\.0\\\\Server\\\\Parameters\\\\Radmin.*")))
